source: Q143 (2026-09-23): builds the Z-Anatomy reference model bundle -- a standalone, unregistered generic body, badged everywhere as Z-Anatomy CC BY-SA 4.0, not registered to either Visible Human specimen (Q142 found registration too inaccurate to ship). See scripts/zanatomy/build_zan_reference.py.

origin.method: least-squares sphere fit (engine.vh_ingest.fit_sphere) to each Femur.l/.r mesh's own proximal-most 15mm-by-atlas-Y cap -- a cheap proxy for the femoral head ball (Z-Anatomy ships no separate femoral head cartilage object); see module docstring for the RMS-vs-cap-size measurement that picked 15mm.
